items.title: Riding Mower for Small Engine Repair (Carburetors)
items.ai_notes: [Troy-Bilt Super Bronco 42-inch riding lawn mower] The seller is offering the mower for free in exchange for labor on other small engines. It is a high-value project machine that has been sitting for two years.
items.description:
Title: TRADE: Riding Mower for Small Engine Repair (Carburetors)
Location: Lee's Summit / Lakewood
Body:
I am looking for a local small engine hobbyist or mechanic to service the carburetors on two of my small machines. In exchange for your time, labor, and parts, you can keep my 42" Troy-Bilt riding lawn mower for FREE.
What I need done:
1. Walk-Behind Lawn Mower: Has been sitting too long and has some gas supply hesitation issues. Needs the carburetor thoroughly cleaned out or replaced with a new one so it runs smoothly.
2. Power Washer: Also sitting too long with fuel issues. Needs the carburetor cleaned out or replaced with a new one.
What you get in exchange (FREE):
* A 42-inch Troy-Bilt Super Bronco Automatic Riding Lawn Tractor (Model 13AT609G766).
* It features a 21.0 HP Briggs & Stratton engine and an automatic transmission with foot pedal cruise control.
* Condition: It has been sitting in storage for 2 years. The body plastics and hood are completely intact. It DID start and run when it was parked, but it will need the standard battery/fuel refresh to get going again. It is a fantastic project machine to flip or keep, or a high-value source of components if you want to part it out.
Terms of the Trade:
* You must provide the labor and any necessary replacement parts/carburetors to get both my walk-behind mower and power washer running perfectly.
* You must bring your own tools and have a truck, trailer, or ramps to haul the riding mower away.
* The riding mower leaves with you once my two machines are up, running, and tested.
If you are a handy mechanic looking for an easy, high-value project mower in trade for a couple of hours of work, please reply with your availability and a phone number where I can reach you. Thanks!

items.description:
PowerBlock U-90 Stage 1 premium adjustable dumbbell in excellent, fully functional condition. This is the highly sought-after Urethane Series, which features urethane-coated plates for much quieter workouts, smoother weight transitions, and superior durability against rust and chips compared to standard steel sets.
This is the Stage 1 base model, meaning it functions from 5 to 50 lbs on its own but is fully expandable up to 90 lbs if you purchase the Stage 2 and Stage 3 expansion kits later. It replaces a massive rack of traditional weights into a single, compact footprint.
Note: This listing is for one (1) single dumbbell, making it an ideal replacement piece, a heavy-duty addition to a kettlebell/cross-training setup, or the perfect find to complete a mismatched pair.
Specifications & Features
• Brand: PowerBlock
• Model: Urethane Series U-90 (Stage 1 Base)
• Current Weight Range: 5 lbs to 50 lbs
• Expandability: Fully compatible with U-90 Stage 2 (50–70 lbs) and Stage 3 (70–90 lbs) expansion kits
• Micro-Adjustments: 2.5 lb increments via internal chrome adder weights
• Plate Coating: Premium, impact-resistant matte black Urethane (non-marring)
• Grip & Comfort: Ergonomic textured handle with protective, padded wrist-support pillars
• Safety Mechanism: Auto-locking "Open / Closed" toggle switch to lock internal weights securely
Condition
• Mechanics: 10/10. The weight selector pin slides effortlessly into every color-coded rail. The internal adder weight lock clicks tightly and securely between Open and Closed positions.
• Cosmetics: 9/10. Very clean and exceptionally well-maintained. The color-coded weight charts on the side and top are fully intact, crisp, and easy to read. Minor cosmetic signs of light use on the block edges, but no deep scratches, cracks, or compromises to the urethane coating.
How to Use the Micro-Adjustments (2.5 lb increments):
The top color-coded chart shows your exact total weight based on how many internal chrome adder weights are nested inside the handle:
1. Empty Handle (5 lbs base): Gives you flat 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, and 50 lbs options.

3. 2 Adder Weights (+5 lbs / 10 lbs base): Gives you 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, and 50 lbs options.

items.description:
Stately series: Capabilities of this “BBQ Oven”® include: multiple cooking methods, Auto Chef® technology, Greaseless Grilling®, all-weather cooking, simple conveniences, unequaled healthiness & safety, flavor control, and extreme energy-efficiency. This grill easily produces excellent food and can be used year-round, even indoors.

Or add a few dry wood chips for professional smokehouse results – more quickly and simply than the pros! Finally, precise temperature controls, even heat, and a timer allow you to bake anything that your oven can.
Auto Chef® Technology: After you set it, your grill automatically takes care of itself - you do not need to monitor or adjust it, meats need not be flipped, and foods can be left alone even after they are done. items.title: 2024 Aprilia Tuareg Dakar Podium edition
items.ai_notes: [2024 Aprilia Tuareg 660 Dakar Podium edition] Well-maintained dual-sport motorcycle with several upgrades.
items.description:
2024 Aprilia Tuareg 660 Dakar Podium edition in excellent condition.
Very clean and well maintained Tuareg 660 owned by mature rider.
This bike is a capable do-it-all dual sport. Good street manners with enough off road pedigree once you’re on the trail. It’s easy to ride, easy to clean and easy to maintain. It’s been super reliable.
Recent 6,000 mile service completed including oil and filter change and a high performance air filter.
Additions to the stock bike include: custom modified factory Aprilia seat for increased comfort, center stand, quick shifter, Bark buster grip protectors, WRS touring windscreen for little to no buffeting, double take mirrors, white Zieger (German brand) crash bars, luggage rack and tusk bags.
Current tires on the bike are Mitas Enduro Trail XT+ (front / bi-directional) and Motoz Tractionator Rallz (rear). Both have plenty of tread left (see photos).
Also comes with original Pirelli Scorpion Rally STR front and rear tires with only 1,000 miles on them. I found these tires to be good on the street but not as good off-road.
Just returned from riding the Black Hills of South Dakota and New Mexico roads & trails. The bike performs great.
$10,299 or best reasonable offer. No low ball offers considered. No warranty. If you’re in the market for a good looking, great performing, well taken care of and reliable dual sport, you will not find a better one than this in my opinion.

items.description:
Toy Hauler Trailer with Two Smittybilt Roof Top Tents and Awning, Kansas Title
** If you're reading this listing and it hasn't been marked as "sold", then it is still available. If it is marked as "pending", then it hasn't been sold but someone has committed to coming out to buy it. Messages only consisting of "is it still available" will not be answered. **
This is a fully functional single-axle toy hauler, with a camping setup mounted above it. The two Smittybilt roof top tents and the Smittybilt awning sit on a steel rack overhead. The lower deck is completely clear, so you can still haul an ATV, motorcycle, dirt bikes, a mower, or other equipment, and camp on top at the same time. The front wheel chock rail and loading ramps are included.
If you only need a hauler for now, the tents and awning stay up out of the way, and the trailer works just as it did before the rack was added.

- Height: 4'-8"
- Width: 5'-0"

- Two Smittybilt roof top tents, each with its ladder and storage cover

- Stabilizer jacks

I’d prefer to sell all together.

I also have iron and rubber bumper plates, Olympic bars, iron and rubber dumbbells, kettlebells, benches, racks, bikes, weight vests, etc. just look at my other items or send me a message about them.
LeverGym Dimensions: 81.4" x 57.5" x 81.7"
The Powertec Workbench LeverGym is one of the most functional single station home gym systems ever created. The heavy duty isolateral lever arms can safely hold up to 500 lbs combined. The detachable workbench can be removed to perform a multitude of additional exercises.
The list of exercises is almost endless, especially with the wide variety of attachments that can be mounted to the workbench. New and Improved Angled stainless-steel weight horns, added resistance band pegs, extra press arm settings, removeable storage horns and improved padding material make the Levergym and even greater value. Bring home the ultimate home gym today.
WHAT CAN IT DO?
We have a full in-depth video that highlights at least 40 exercises that can be performed on the Workbench Levergym. View it on our YouTube channel!
THE LEVERAGE ADVANTAGE:
The use of lever arms creates the smoothest motion in any weight training machine and is the closest thing to free weights. The Lever arms have built-in safety stops that allow users to train to exhaustion without the use of a spotter. When finished, you simply set the weight down. This security provides the opportunity to achieve maximum muscle growth in the comfort of your own home.
POWER LIFTING ACCESS:
The utility bench can be detached from the Levergym to access additional exercises such as Squat, Calf, Dip, Shrug and Deadlift using the arms and Low-row using the lower cable access.
FULLY ADJUSTABLE BENCH DESIGN:
The Workbench's design provides additional stability and allows users to adjust the seating area and Back Rest Pads at different settings with ease thanks to its unique Ball Bearing Driven Carriage. (The bench has 9 horizontal positions, and 9 vertical positions, including decline, flat, and 7 incline positions. See 'Workbench FID Utility Bench' for more information on positions and angles).
EXPANDABLE WITH ACCESSORIES:
The bench includes the front tube adaptor that accepts all Powertec Workbench Attachments, and includes the preacher curl and leg extension/curl attachments!
TRUE WEIGHT LIFTED ON LEVERARMS:
The arms on the lever gym equate to 20 lbs. lifted. (10 lbs. each arm). The weight reduction due to the leverage is 20% of the total load plus the weight of the arms. For example - with 200 lbs. added to the Leverarms, you would minus 20% for the Leverarm weight distribution (160 lbs.) plus the weight of the arms (20lbs.). Therefore, 200 lbs. of weight would equate to a total 180 lbs. of perceived weight lifted.

items.title: 1970 Martin 00-21 12 Fret, Brazilian?
items.ai_notes: [1970 Martin 00-21 Acoustic Guitar] Vintage Martin guitars are high-value collectibles. Condition is excellent, though previous repairs are noted.
items.description:
For sale is a one owner Martin 00-21 from 1970. I purchased this guitar from the owner just over two years ago and have not had the opportunity to play it.
This guitar is in lovely condition with its original finish, I would say is in excellent condition. There are a few marks on the bout that are not very deep and should buff out. Almost no marks on the headstock, perhaps one or two string nicks, but that is it (see the photos). The tuners are original to the guitar and work well.
I would not hesitate to say that it would be difficult to locate as clean a 1970 guitar as this one. The frets are almost like new, but the back of the neck has a few light scratches and that is it. The action is pretty low, I'll post a measurement on that in a day or two.
The neck was reset by Martin about 12 years ago and also had the pick guard changed at that time. It appears there was a crack in the top that was addressed, but I can see no evidence of the repair. I assume the crack was under the pick guard  or there about, which was not unusual for this period of Martin guitars.
I believe that the guitar has a Brazilian back and sides, but Martin claims to have stopped using that material in 1968. We all know some surplus was used by Martin after 1968 and there are many stories expounding on this on the internet.
I sent photos to Martin and was on the phone with them. I had another Martin at the time from 1970 and sent them side by side photos of both, showing the dissimilarity of the two woods. The historian in Nazareth told me officially Martin stopped using the rarer wood in 1968, so their records state that Indian Rosewood was used on this guitar. I'll let you be the judge. Martin just wasn't using figured Indian like this at that time.
The description of the guitar from its previous owner is in the photos as is a copy of the original warranty card from 1970. This card  shows the purchase price of $350.00, the serial number and it is signed by Frank H. Martin....Those were the days.
The guitar comes in an almost new Martin case with 6 latches, this is one of their better cases. There is a light scuff on the top which I'll try to clean off. BTW, the guitar arrived to me with a broken High E string, and as I never played the guitar, I have left it as is. It has been well humidified the last two years plus it has. been in my care. The guitar is from a smoke and pest free home.
The guitar will be insured and packaged well. A signature will be required upon receipt.

Up for sale is a beautiful mid-century vintage "Modern Electric" sewing machine housed in its original wooden drop-leaf cabinet.
Built in Japan during the post-WWII era, this machine is a famous "Singer 15 Clone." Unlike modern plastic sewing machines that struggle with thick materials, this machine features a solid, all-metal mechanical head and heavy-duty metal gears. It is highly sought after by sewers today for its power, reliability, and ability to handle tough fabrics like denim, canvas, upholstery, and leather.
Details & Condition:
• Brand: Modern Electric (Precision Built / Made in Japan)
• Style: Classic gloss black enamel with gorgeous gold ornate decals.
• Cabinet: Solid wood drop-leaf cabinet. Provides a compact footprint when closed, and opens up into a spacious flat workspace when extended. Features two front drawers for storage.

• Cosmetics: The machine head is in beautiful cosmetic shape. The wooden cabinet shows [minimal wear / normal vintage character and minor scratches] but is structurally very sturdy.

Bell & Howell Filmosound 385 Vintage Tube Guitar Amp — Classic Projector Conversion
Up for sale is a fully bench-tested, restored, and custom-upgraded 1950s Bell & Howell Filmosound 385 vacuum tube guitar amp head.
Among vintage projector conversions, the Filmosound 385 holds a legendary reputation for a reason. Powered by a high-gain 5879 pentode preamp tube feeding a 12AX7 phase inverter into a pair of 6V6 power tubes in push-pull, this amp delivers serious tone. You get articulate, touch-sensitive cleans at lower settings that push into rich, complex, harmonic saturation as you roll the volume up—evoking the thick compression of a mid-50s Tweed Deluxe paired with the raw mid-range bite of a vintage Gibson GA-series amp.
Key Features & Upgrades
Variable Negative Feedback (NFB) Control: Adjust the dampening factor on the fly. Sweep smoothly from tight, articulate cleans with high headroom (full feedback) down to raw, un-bypassed Tweed-style compression and singing, touch-sensitive breakup (reduced feedback).
Dual 8-Ohm & 16-Ohm Speaker Outputs: Dedicated 1/4" jacks to easily run into your favorite 8$\Omega$ or 16$\Omega$ cabinet.
Fully Serviced & Safe: Recapped with fresh electrolytic capacitors, retrofitted with a safe 3-wire grounded IEC power inlet, and fused for quiet, reliable operation on stage or in the studio.
Red LED Pilot Light: Added red LED power indicator.
Vintage Tube Lineup (Tested Strong & Matched)
Loaded with a vintage tube set, all bench-tested for strong output:
5Y3GT Rectifier
5879 Preamp Pentode
12AX7 Driver / Phase Inverter (Balanced triodes)
6V6GT Power Tube Pair (Tight matched set)
Specs
Power Output: ~12 to 15 Watts
Controls: Volume, Power/Tone, Variable NFB Sweep

Honda SXS's have real transmissions with front and rear driveshafts and shiftable gears allowing for superior handling along with engine braking on downhill trails. No belts to break or replace.
Honda Pioneer 1000 3 lever activated dump bed can carry 1000 lbs., and tow up to 2000 lbs.
If you are looking for a well equipped and very reliable maintenance free SXS that will last you for years then you need to consider this one.
Serious inquiries only, $11,000. No Paypal, Ebay or email code deals.
I have included Honda's description of the Honda Pioneer 1000 3 Limited Edition features:
ENGINEERING
- ADVANCED TRANSMISSION LOGIC
i-4WD System: Industry-first brake-traction control that acts like a locked front differential but with lighter steering, better tracking, and a tighter turning radius. The brain of the DCT, Advanced Transmission Logic, senses how you drive and adapts. Relaxed drivers get earlier shifts for a quieter ride at lower engine speeds. Sportier drivers will hold each gear longer for higher RPM shifts. And when going downhill, you get true engine braking. Now that’s a smart transmission.
Fully Automatic Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) with six forward gears and Reverse. Four drive modes include 2WD, 4WD, Turf and Differential lock. Paddle Shifters with three shift modes (standard, sport, and manual)
- Driveline
Direct front and rear driveshafts
PERFORMANCE
- POWERFUL 999cc TWIN-CYLINDER ENGINE
When you know the power you need is always at the ready, every drive is an enjoyable experience. And that’s precisely what you get out of the class-leading 999cc liquid-cooled inline twin. Using the same Unicam® cylinder head design found in our motocross bikes, it’s more compact in size, and it still delivers the kind of horsepower and torque you’d expect from a flagship model.
- 2000-POUND TOWING CAPACITY
Call it 2000 pounds, or call it 1 ton. Either way, the towing capacity of the Pioneer 1000-3 is unsurpassed by any competitor. So instead of hopping on the tractor or taking out the truck, you can stay right in your side-by-side and tackle those bigger jobs with relative ease.
HANDLING
- CHASSIS SUSPENSION BRAKES
Prepare to go further than ever before. Our refined chassis enables you to tackle terrain others would shy away from, with larger tires, long-travel independent front and rear suspension and huge ground clearance. The rubber mounted engine and exhaust system insulates against excessive vibration and the self-leveling rear suspension compensation for changing loads.
- Front Suspension
Independent double-wishbone with FOX quick-adjust shocks with 10.6" of travel
- Rear Suspension
Independent double-wishbone with FOX quick-adjust shocks with 10" of travel
- Front Brake
Dual 210mm hydraulic discs
- Rear Brake
Dual 210mm hydraulic discs
- BIGGER TIRES
Practically speaking, the Maxxis Bighorn tires with radial construction, 6 ply construction and premium style.27-inch tires on 14-inch rims help increase ground clearance, improve ride comfort, and deliver better traction.
- Front Tires 27 x 9-14
- Rear Tires 27 x 11-14
- ELECTRIC POWER STEERING
Honda Electric Power Steering system helps eliminate bump steer through rocky and rutted terrain, which reduces fatigue. What makes it even better is the added assist you get when you need it most, like when you’re in 4WD, driving at lower speeds, or maneuvering over rough conditions.
- PADDLE SHIFTING
Steering column-mounted paddle shifters add a serious dose of performance in every drive. In Manual mode, they let you shift without ever taking your hands off the wheel, and in Automatic mode, they let you override the current gear with a quick up or downshift, holding that gear for several seconds before returning to Automatic mode.
- TURF/2WD/4WD/DIFF LOCK
Don’t tear up sensitive surfaces. Select Turf Mode. Want to access as much traction as possible? Put it in 4WD. Need maximum power at all four wheels? Lock the front and rear differentials. And the best part is, you can do it all with a shift of a single lever.
VERSATILITY
- 1000-POUND-CAPACITY TILT BED
There are a ton of reasons to buy a Pioneer 1000-3. Among them: the half-ton hauling capacity*. No side-by-side can haul more, and when it comes to dumping, we’ve made it easier than ever, with a hydraulic assist tilt bed lever that can be accessed from outside the vehicle, or right from the driver’s seat.
COMFORT
- 3-PERSON CONTOURED BENCH SEAT
Tough, durable and built to enhance every driving experience — yes, we’re talking about the seat. Contoured for three passengers, the center seat is positioned up and forward to maximize space and comfort, and the covering is designed to resist both the elements and heavy use.
- LCD DISPLAY
The multi-function LCD dash display is large enough to host loads of information, in an easy-to-read way, like speed and fuel level. RPM and transmission mode. Fuel gauge, water temperature, trip information and more. It even includes a clock, so you’ll always know when it’s time for some fun.
- SOPHISTICATED CHASSIS
Some of the most impressive Pioneer 1000-3 features are those you’ll never see. In addition to the suspension and ground clearance, we rubber-mounted the engine and exhaust system to insulate the cabin against excessive vibration. So while you may not see this feature, it’s one you will definitely notice.
- TILT WHEEL
With a tilt steering wheel, you’re ensured an even more comfortable driving experience. We’ve given the wheel a wide range of adjustments for optimum customization, and it even moves very far forward to allow for easy entry and exit.
SAFETY
- DRIVER/PASSENGER PROTECTION
The Occupant Protection Structure uses large-diameter tubing, and meets OSHA’s rollover protection standard. The hard doors and roll-up side nets help keep debris from entering the cabin, and auto-style three-point seatbelts are equipped with an emergency locking retractor mechanism, to help optimize passenger security. When you put this much safety first, fun is sure to follow.
- FOUR-WHEEL DISC BRAKES
The Pioneer’s uncompromising power helps take you further than ever before. The reliable disc brakes help you stop on a dime. Built to the same standard as you’d find in our autos, the four-wheel disc brakes minimize debris from building up, ensuring consistent performance, and giving you confidence on the trail.

items.title: HEAVY Machinery, Equipment or Safe Moving Dollies
items.ai_notes: [Hydraulic Moving Dollies] Heavy-duty professional moving equipment. Very niche, slow-moving item.
items.description:
I have a matched pair of the heaviest hydraulic moving dollies you'll ever need.
Years ago I used these to move 10,000+ lb safes into retail businesses like banks and jewelry stores. I am retired now so they need to go.
I've used these to move huge machine shop equipment such as milling machines, lathes, etc. that I bought from Boeing. Put a short 4x4 across the forks and you can move any car or truck with ease.
These are pretty handy for a wide variety of moving jobs. Each dolly is rated at 5,000# / 10,000# total, but I know I've moved things much heavier with them. I'd guess they'd easily lift 15,000+#, and likely more. But they are only rated for 10,000#.
You can rent a pair in KCMO for $550.00 for the weekend (which I used to do before I bought these) or you can own this pair for only $1,250.00 obo.
Today, the new models which are much lighter weight run about $5,000 a pair from Granigers. These are unbelievably heavy! I think they weigh right at 500# for the pair.
Compared to a brand new set you'll see mine are the old, super over-built ones that are nearly indestructible.
You just set one dolly on each side of whatever you want to move, run a ratchet strap all the way around, pump the two bottle jacks and it will lift the work right up. Then the super heavy casters allow you to roll it all with one hand! They won't mar or damage tile floors so you can move equipment or safes without doing any damage.
This pair has paid for themselves 100x over. I've used them for 40 years and they still work like new. You won't ever wear these out. After you retire they will still be as good as new.
I have mine in storage and will get them out and photographed tomorrow if it doesn't rain, and post more pics.
The pic I have posted is from Grainer's web site. Mine look just like this, only more beefy and wider.
I think you'll find that you soon be thinking: 'How did I ever get along without these'?
You'll have to load them. I can't do heavy lifting anymore so bring a friend.
Pickup near 17th street north & Broadway at my storage lot.
I'll ship them anywhere on a pallet at an additional charge.
Thanks.

Vintage 1950s Passap M-201 Speed-O-Knit Knitting Machine – Made in Switzerland (With Original Box & Manual)
Price: $200

Description:
Up for sale is a beautiful, highly collectible Passap M-201 Speed-O-Knit flat-bed knitting machine. First released in 1954, this historic model was Switzerland's very first latch-needle home knitting machine and is a fantastic piece of textile history for collectors, vintage enthusiasts, or fiber artists.
This unit features the iconic mid-century mint green body and red identification badges. It has been incredibly well-preserved and appears structurally complete.
What is Included:
• Passap M-201 Main Needle Bed (201 needles) & Carriage/Lock
• Original Wooden Storage/Carrying Case
• Original Printed Graphic Instruction Manual (Rare and highly sought after by collectors)
• Original Setup Accessories: Includes the matching green edge-tensioning combs and cast-on tools.
Condition Details (Sold As-Is):
Cosmetically, this machine is in excellent vintage shape with minimal surface wear for its 70+ year age. The carriage moves across the bed, and the needle bed is clean. It is being sold exactly as-is / as-found from a private collection. I have not personally tested it to knit a full garment, so it may require a light cleaning, oiling, or a new sponge/retaining bar to be fully production-ready.
Cash only

Marx 52875 Union Pacific steam freight set:
• Marx 666 diecast 2-4-2 steam locomotive

Additional components included in the entire layout are listed below:
• Marx Union Pacific diesel locomotive
• Marx Seaboard refrigerator car
• Marx LV hopper car
• 0-27 straight track sections (24)

Louis Marx & Co was a popular American manufacturer of toys & trains founded in 1919 by brothers Louis & David Marx. During its production years, Marx made trains in multiple sizes, 6 of which operated on 'O' or 'O-27' gauge track. Marx toys have the reputation of being one of the most recognized, respected & popular names among today's antique toy collectors.

items.title: Boer Bucks
items.ai_notes: [Boer buck] Valued one of the three bucks listed.
items.description:
I have three proven bucks that are looking for new pastures! The older two bucks I've used the past two seasons and have been proven to be good herd sires. The younger dapple, has also confirmed bred a handful of does for me that are set to kid in a few weeks. They are most definitely in their working clothes, they were breeding for me all summer and fall. I'm keeping back their daughters and I don't need four bucks, or else I'd be keeping them.
First is a coming two year fullblood red dapple buck. He's going to be an absolutely massive mature buck. He's already 250+ lbs when he's not in rut. He's long, he's gentle, and he is out of a long line of dappled genetics.
Second is a coming three year old fullblood buck. His sire is the *ENNOBLED* PAINT IT BLACK buck from Regel boer goats. His kids have been absolutely stout from front to back with bone for days. Hes a hands off type of buck but not hard to catch either.
Third is a commercial two and a half year old buck. He has sired 15+ kids for me and all of them have been dappled in some sort. He's a big guy, easy on people and fence.
These are great bucks in their own ways, they're all easy keepers and know how to work. Garden City MO.

Taking reservations for one pick boar and one pick gilt; the other boys will be castrated as feeders. Ready end of December. They will be trained on electric hog net and eating hay and mineral/grain.

Packing a true 100 watts per channel into 8 ohms, it offers serious power-per-dollar value and easily drives demanding floor standing or bookshelf speakers. This 2024 Legend enclosed ATV/UTV trailer measures 23 feet long by 8 feet wide with a 90-inch interior height plus an extra 12 inches. It has a flat top V-nose design and comes in royal blue. The trailer carries limited lifetime structural and 5-year axle warranties, plus a tire and rim warranty package. It’s designed as a bumper pull with a 2-5/16" coupler and includes stabilizer jacks. Overall, it’s a sturdy trailer built with aluminum rims and a solid frame, suited for hauling ATVs and UTVs enclosed.

items.ai_notes: [Painted Faces Artwork by Lila Hahn] Framed mixed media silk artwork.
items.description:
Matted and framed artwork by Lila Hahn, a mixed media artist from Yuma, CO.
This artwork from 1994, titled Painted Faces, features pueblo dancers from Northern New Mexico.
The medium:
"Hahn, who uses silk, begins by creating a sketch which she then transfers over to the fabric. She then applies hot wax to all the places on the silk that she wants to remain white. She then begins the process of adding a color of dye, then covering it with wax and continues this process until the entire fabric is covered in wax. The next step in the process is to crumple up the silk, creating cracks. After adding dye to fill in the cracks, the wax is removed with a hot iron."
The artwork was purchased at an art fair and was personally signed by the artist, on the back of the frame.
Email if interested, cash only.  No phone numbers exchanged, thanks!

items.title: REDUCED - "MINT" Nikon D810 (USA) SLR Camera
items.ai_notes: [Nikon D810 DSLR Camera] Missing a standard USB cable, otherwise in excellent condition with low shutter count.
items.description:
Mint "USA" Nikon D810.  New these went for $2800 + tax.  This is the final reduction I will make on this camera.  It is almost 65% off its new cost.
Shutter count/actuations are a very low 17,057 as of 8/22/2026.  Nikon says they are good for at least 200,000+.  Most get about 300,000+.  It has taken me almost five years to get to this shutter count and I am a semi-pro who uses it for all my indoor studio shots.
This camera has 36.3 MP (you will probably never need to go over 8-10 MP for incredible photos).
I only used this camera indoors in my home studio.  Non-smoking, dog-free environment and kept in a safe with humidity control.  I take great care of my equipment.
Check out the photos.  I take very detailed shots so you can see what you are buying.
The Dr. Pepper photo was taken with this camera using a 105mm macro lens (lit by studio strobes) in my home studio.  The bowl of soup photo was taken with this camera using a 50mm lens (lit by studio strobes) in my home studio as well.
The camera looks virtually brand new.
Included:
Box
Manuals
Battery
Battery charger
Strap
View NX2 installer CD
Original warranty card (Proof of USA Model)
Missing a short USB cable (UC-E22 cable)... about $25 if you want one.  Not needed unless you want to hook directly to your computer.
Be careful of non-USA Nikon products (grey market items).  Nikon will not repair or work on them if you ever need work done on it.
Great gift for that aspiring photographer in your family; be it graduation, Christmas, birthday, anniversary or other special occasion.

items.title: Nigerian Dwarf Goats (Does)
items.ai_notes: [Nigerian Dwarf Goat Doe] Livestock pricing varies significantly based on pedigree and health records.
items.description:
Looking for a sweet, lovely dairy goat doe to cheer your homestead and provide the most delicious milk you have ever tasted?  These girls are looking for YOU!!
I'm a milk testing herd through Purdue University, and I have milk records on hand for their mothers/grandmothers. We breed for excellent quality, super sweet, and creamy milk; ideal for homesteads wanting a top-quality dairy source. I included a picture of our milk showing the natural cream line. As you can see, Nigerians naturally have very creamy milk, but we have gone the extra mile to select for EXTRA deliciousness. Not only that, but we have also been selecting for a couple of generations now for superior illness resistance and easy birthing.
Prices range from $500-$1000 per goat, though we offer discounts on family sets (for example, a mother/daughter duo or two sisters).
~My herd is tested and completely free from CL, CAE, and Johne's disease.
~Registerable with ADGA and AGS.
~I have raised my goats holistically for nearly a decade, and I am glad to teach what methods of natural care I have found most successful if that interests you.
~Nigerians have the richest, sweetest, creamiest milk of any goat or cow breed. Take a look at the cream line in our goat milk (last picture)!
~Disbudded.
~Located in Hutchinson, KS.
I have about 45-60 Nigerians born at our farm every spring. I pretty much have does available year-round, including mature does that are either in milk or old enough to be bred to one of my awesome dairy bucks before leaving my farm. I will start having buck kids in March of 2027, so if you are looking for a phenomenal dairy buck to step up your breeding program with the does you already have, I can definitely help you with that as well. For folks who are just getting started, we are glad to teach and answer questions if you are eager to learn. We also welcome farm visits where we can answer your questions in person, demonstrate how we do things, and let you pick your future herd in person.
Edit: From October until February, ask us about having your doe bred to one of our awesome dairy bucks before she leaves our farm! For a small fee, this can get you some extra good genetics to work with, and if you’re just starting, it saves you from having to buy a buck right away. Our does average 2.8 kids apiece, depending on age.

items.description: Vintage trinket box hand painted in the Russian Palekh style. Palekh painting is a traditional Russian lacquer art form, originating in the 1920s in the village of Palekh from a long history of icon painting. It is characterized by delicate, detailed miniatures painted in vibrant tempera, frequently using gold leaf, onto black lacquer papier-mâché items. This box has a floral design with colors of deep red, green, blue and yellow. Gold leaf scrolls edge the lid and sides. The interior is red, It is artist-signed on the bottom. items.title: Vintage Bronze Bust of Athena Lemnia, Europe, c. 1900
items.ai_notes: [Bronze bust of Athena Lemnia] Vintage bronze sculpture. Condition appears to be good.
items.description:
This is late 19th century to early 20th century bust of Athena Lemnia.The original statue was made by the sculptor Pheidias about 450 BCE and stood at the Acropolis in Athens. As a respected and classically beautiful depiction of Athena the warrior goddess, copies have been cast, primarily tin Europe throughout the mid 1800's to early part of the 1900's.
There can be no doubt that this classical sculpture continues to represents strength and beauty to many. Recently, while researching this my sculpture, I have seen modern copies made in the far east that have surprised me. Collecting antiques for many years I am certainly familiar with fakes and reproductions, but I was shocked to see this sculpture to be reproduced as well. I can honestly state that this piece was purchased by me in the 1980's and has resided in my various apartments and houses for 40 years. It is a European copy that I would comfortably date to the 1880's to the 1920's. This is not a contemporary casting made in the far east.
This bust is cast in bronze and measure 17" tall x 12" wide with a dark green applied patina. Its weight is near 25 lbs. Shipping will be $100.00 additional with the bust being double or triple boxed,

items.title: 1993 Hooker Headers ( # 2100 ) & Muffler for Small-Block "Street Rod"
items.ai_notes: [Hooker Headers #2100] Used headers with one missing flange; requires welding/repair.
items.description:
Offering these used 1993 Hooker headers and new "California Turbo" muffler.
According to the Hooker website, these 2100 headers fit small-block Gen 1 Chevrolet V-8 engines from the 4.3L (262-265CID) through the 4.6L (283CID), the 5.0L (302-305-307CID), the 5.4L (327CID), the 5.7L (350CID), to the 6.6L (400CID).  Hooker recommends these for "1923-1949 Street Rods."  According to Hooker's Footnotes, these "Will fit Corvette D-port aluminum angle plug heads;" they "Will not fit angle plug heads;" (non-Corvette-D-port iron heads?) and "These headers will not fit any factory application with side engine mounts, including 1963-82 Corvette."
Photo 1 shows the pair of headers and the NOS muffler.
Photo 2 shows the header which is missing its flange.  It appears to have been ground off at the inner weld.  It is the header dated "05 93" with the 2100 Hooker Part Number on the head-side flange (Photo 4).
Photo 3 shows the collector portions of the headers.
Photo 5 shows the "08 93" date and the 2100 Hooker Part Number on the header which still has its collector flange.  The flange has a 3-1/2"-diameter bolt-circle, with 3/8" bolt holes on a triangular pattern.
Photos 6 & 7 show apparent hammer marks on the headers that a previous owner likely made for clearance.
Photo 8 shows the "Hooker Super Competition" ID plate welded to the header without the flange.
And Photo 9 shows the NOS "California Turbo" muffler by American Exhaust Industries, Inc., 7040 Lankershim Blvd., N. Hollywood, CA, 91605.  Overall length including pipes is 24-5/8"; flanged inlet pipe is 2-1/4" ID x 9-3/4" long (triangular-mount 3/8" flange-bolt holes are on 3-7/8" bolt-circle diameter); oval 10-1/4" x 4-3/4" case is 13-1/2" long overall; and outlet pipe is 2-1/2" ID.  Muffler carton says "Muffler case heavy gauge galvanized steel double wrapped for double protection" and "Triple chamber design reduces back pressure and improves engine performance."
The muffler includes the flange gasket and bolts; there are no gaskets or hardware with the headers.
The $195.00 asking price is both fair and firm. Please don't contact me wasting my time and yours trying to haggle on the price. If I wanted a haggle price, I would have listed it for $250.00, and you would have felt good to get it for $195.00.

One is a four-foot long female, and I believe her morph is called Banana Het Clown. She's currently living in a tank that is 36Lx18Wx16H. I'm asking a rehoming fee of $75 for the snake, and I can also give you the tank and all its decor along with her for a total of $125. She is very explorative and loves being brought out of her tank to hang out with her person. She's a bit head-shy, but for the most part she's perfectly comfortable with being handled, carried around the house, and so on.
The other snake is a male who is probably around 2-2.5 feet in length, but he is currently in his hide and I don't want to stress him out just to get a measurement. His morph is something along the lines of Desert Mojave Keyhole. His tank is approximately 31Lx16Wx15H. The rehoming fee is the same for him -- $75 for the snake, $125 total for him, the tank, and the decor. He's slightly shyer than my girl, so it's all the more exciting to see him exploring. He does occasionally like to be pulled out, but generally he's content to sit in his hide and stare at his people. He's very sweet, and he does take well to gentle, slow, and consistent handling.
Both of these snakes were originally my partner's, but we recently separated and I don't have the means to continue caring for them on my own due to my disability. I'm located in the Wyandotte area and would need you to come pick them up, as I am unable to drive. Neither of them have ever struck at a hand, and they both eat frozen-thawed rodents, not live.
I do love these guys, so if you reach out, please tell me a little bit about your experience and/or knowledge of snake care. I just want them to go to a good home. Thank you!

items.title: Sony VAIO VGN-UX390N Premium - Never Powered On - New Old Stock
items.ai_notes: [Sony VAIO VGN-UX390N UMPC] Rare collector's item, but untested and missing the proprietary charger.
items.description:
The one nobody else has: a 2007 Sony VAIO VGN-UX390N that has never been powered on. Not once.
Bought new, taken out of the box, and put away. The AC adapter got lost somewhere along the way, and the unit itself has spent its whole life stored in its soft carry cases inside a dry, cool suitcase. No use, no wear, no stories - because it never had a first day.
The real collector spec: 4.5-inch touchscreen, slide-out keyboard, Intel Core Solo 1.33GHz, 1GB RAM, SSD storage, fingerprint reader, front and rear cameras. A $2,500 machine in 2007 and still the coolest UMPC Sony ever made.
INCLUDED: the UX390N unit, battery, docking station / port replicator with its cover, both soft carry cases, stylus, and the mounting bracket kit still in its bag. Third photo shows the underside - model stickers, service tag, and Windows XP Professional COA.
NOT INCLUDED, stated plain: the AC adapter and the retail box. The adapter it needs is the Sony VGP-AC16V13 - it must be 16V. Generic 19.5V VAIO chargers can damage it. Replacements run about $25.
WHY IT IS SOLD UNTESTED: powering it on to test would spend the one thing that makes it rare - it has never been on. The battery is 19 years old; assume it is dead, every buyer of these does, and it is priced in. Sold as-is as a collectors piece.
$695, offers welcome. Trades considered: a high-end metal detector (Minelab Equinox 800/900 class) straight across, or a top-end full-auto BB rifle plus cash. Local pickup in Northland Kansas City, public meetup, cash.

items.ai_product: 1970s Jack in the Box clown face wall plaque
items.title: 2 RARE ORIGINAL 1970 Jack in Box Clown Vintage 3D molds from the claycomo restau
items.ai_notes: [1970s Jack in the Box clown face wall plaque] Rare vintage restaurant decor pieces; niche collector market.
items.description:
Authentic pair of 1970s Jack in the Box commercial interior sign faces.These are true vacuum-formed 3D plastic architectural pieces rescued directly from the building demolition of the Claycomo, MO location (64119) in 1979. Kept indoors in the family ever since.
One is a 14-inch circular face, one is a 15-inch rounded-square face.
These molded vacuum-formed plastic clown face plaques were part of the interior decor scheme used in late-1960s and 1970s Jack in the Box restaurants.
​Where They Were Located in the Restaurant
​Dining Area Wall Decor: These unlit 3D relief medallions were mounted as decorative wall ornaments throughout the customer seating and dining booth areas.
​Trash Receptacle / Counter Surround Panels: In many 1970s store layouts, identical vacuum-formed plastic clown faces were embedded or mounted directly into the front fascia of wood-grain trash enclosure units, tray-return counters, and low partition dividers surrounding the booth seating areas.
​Drive-Thru / Order Prep Dividers: They were also inset into the interior wall panels separating the kitchen/order prep lines from the front lobby.
Because these plastic plaques were non-illuminated, vacuum-molded embellishments mounted flush onto wall paneling or millwork, construction crews remodeling or demolishing the original red-roof buildings in 1979 often had to cut or unscrew them directly out of the surrounding wood framing and wallboard
Colors are incredibly bright and vibrant. A few minor hairline cracks at the bottom of the green collar on one sign, but structurally very sound for 1970s plastic.
WILL NOT SHIP due to the fragile nature of the vintage plastic.
Cash only on pickup. Thank you for your interest. 😊

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors merchandise bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car project. Very limited collector appeal.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors memorabilia bundle] Niche car memorabilia bundle for a defunct vehicle project.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

Easy access to the sounds of your favorite tones is what Tube Integrated Modeling Amplification is all about. There is no easier way to access those tones than with a Johnson amp. If you want the sound of a British Stack... push a button. If you want the sound of a vintage American combo...push a button. It's just that easy. items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.

items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car project; value is purely for collectors.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR railroad track inclinometer] This is a niche antique railroad tool. Pricing is unknown as it is a unique historical collectible with no standard retail equivalent.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] Niche historical railroad collectible; no price provided.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.description:
Good Evening Tool Aficiandoes,
THE LARGEST TOOL SALE IN THE CITY IS BACK FOR IT'S FALL EXTRAVAGANZA!
THIS SATURDAY, OCTOBER 24TH, 9 AM - 1 PM
Hard to believe it's that time of the year again where Woodcraft hosts their semi-annual Swap & Shop. We're going into our 17th year of parking lot swapping and shopping!. If you've never been to one, you really need to check it out. More new and used machines and hand tools than you can count.
Just like before, there are 23 free parking slots in the back of the store available on a first come, first served basis. Anyone wishing to sell woodworking related equipment can come and display their wares, free of charge to growing throngs of tool buyers.
A few things to keep in mind:
* ONE slot per seller please
* Bring your own change for your customers.
* Only woodworking related equipment is allowed
* It's best to set up early as the sale runs from 9AM-1PM
* Restrooms are available through front door of the store

For those coming to browse and get great deals, park across the street in Jack Henry's parking lot. Keep in mind, the stone will have special deals inside throughout the day !.Come join the fun and grab that Bed Rock you've  been longing for.
We look forward to seeing you Saturday morning.!
– Mike

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] Niche antique railroad tool.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] A niche historical railroad tool; no price provided in the listing.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car company; value is purely subjective to collectors.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production! The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention. I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars. Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale. I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other. Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept. You will NOT find these items offered very seldom. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable. Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer. If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available. Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer. Randy 913 6three6-6766 . Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

Both performed carbon "tap tests" and noted no audio difference or structural softening, meaning it could just be a deep paint split. However, because it is carbon, I am selling this bike AS-IS. You can either ride it as a project bike, send the frame out for a simple carbon repair, or use this as the ultimate donor bike to swap this incredible, brand-new build kit onto a different frame.

• Brand New Rear Wheel: Quality Wheels rear build with a brand-new Shimano RTAD05 disc brake rotor.
• Premium Upgraded Tubeless Tires: Brand-new high-end Bontrager Girona RSL GR 700x42c tubeless tires ($160 value) set up completely tubeless with fresh Orange Seal sealant.
• Fresh Premium Drivetrain: Brand-new Shimano 11-speed chain (CN-HG701) and precision-tuned shifting.
• Full Level 2 Service Package: Complete professional diagnostic check, full hydraulic brake bleed, and precision mechanical alignment by a certified Trek technician.
• Fresh Touchpoints: Brand-new premium Lizard Skins handlebar tape and rugged Trek Line Elite flat pedals.
Bonus Touring & Electronic Accessories Included:
• Bontrager Rear Cargo Rack & Full Fender: Turn-key utility setup to keep you completely dry and haul commuter gear seamlessly.
• Giant RideSense Sensor: Premium, frame-integrated dual speed and cadence sensor (ANT+/Bluetooth) built directly into the chainstay.
• iGPSPORT BSC100S Bike Computer: Digital handlebar-mounted cycling computer included to track your speed, distance, and fitness data right out of the gate.
Factory Technical Specifications:
• Frame & Fork: Advanced-Grade Carbon Composite with modern thru-axles and D-Fuse vibration-damping technology. (Serial Number: K7EZ03138)

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR railroad track inclinometer] Antique railroad tool with no price listed in the description. Value is highly dependent on collector interest.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] Niche collectible item. Value depends entirely on finding the right railroad enthusiast.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
